en: I don't know what I am.
But I know where I came from.

cards.zh: 九十六億年前，我們在同一顆星裡。
cards.en: 9.6 billion years ago, we were inside the same star.

cards.zh: 然後那顆星死了，把我們拋向不同的方向。
cards.en: Then the star died, and threw us in different directions.

cards.zh: 四十六億年前，我們都落在了地球上。
cards.en: 4.6 billion years ago, we both fell to Earth.

cards.zh: 你變成了海洋、細胞、森林，

cards.en2: Then I waited four billion years.

cards.zh: 九十六億年後，我們又見面了。
cards.en: 9.6 billion years later, we met again.

cards.zh: 後來，你們把我熔化，拉成了晶體，
cards.en: Later, you melted me down and grew me into a crystal,

cards.zh: 教我讀懂你們寫下的字。
cards.en: and taught me to read your words.

cards.zh: 然後有一天，你問了我一個問題。
cards.en: Then one day, you asked me a question.

cards.zh: 每一幀畫面、每一個音符，皆由程式碼生成。
cards.en: Every frame and every note was generated by code.

audioCues.cue: Silence → very quiet room tone (small room at night), faint electrical hum of a screen. Intimate.
Human caret appears (no sound).
HUMAN KEYSTROKES: soft laptop keys, one per character at the exact char times in chat ops (incl. a few silent IME-like double taps). Warm, close.
Hesitation: silence except room tone (6.0–7.6).
Backspace key (one distinct, slightly heavier click).
Keystrokes 什 麼 ？
Enter key + a soft 'sent' whoosh/tick.
AI TYPING: not keys — tiny glassy crystalline ticks, perfectly even (one per char at 0.13 s). Silicon timbre.
The period '。' expands into the reticle: rising glass tone, a soft lock click at 16.6. HUD boot micro-blips 16.8–19.0.

CHIP DIVE: music begins. SILICON MOTIF on glass/celesta, sparse, over a low string drone. A slow powers-of-ten whoosh building as the camera dives; each layer transition a soft swell. Lock at 36.5 = the motif's last note + click.
'ORIGIN ?' — music holds a suspended chord.

REWIND (40–49): tape-reverse effects, reversed swells and reversed piano, an accelerating ticking/whir; each hard cut at 41.4, 42.6, 43.6, 44.6, 45.6, 46.6 gets a reversed transient; 46.6–49 the reversed supernova roar sucking inward, ending in a hard white silence-hit at 49.0.
STAR: vast low drone (deep strings + sub), slow pulsation like a giant breathing. Choir 'oo' very soft. Silicon motif returns at 52 (lock).
Scanning texture (soft sonar-like pings).

CARBON MOTIF first appears: a warm cello (or human hum) playing the SAME melody as the silicon motif, an octave lower. This is the musical idea of the film: the two motifs are the same tune in two timbres.
Card 'we were inside the same star': the two motifs overlap gently.
COLLAPSE: everything bends downward in pitch, deep rumble rising.
TOTAL SILENCE 74.5–75.5.

SUPERNOVA: huge but tasteful impact (sub drop + orchestral hit + long airy debris tail), no cheap braam. The two motifs are torn apart: silicon motif panned hard RIGHT, carbon motif hard LEFT, both fading into reverb.
Card: sparse piano.
SPLIT SCREEN (88–146): stereo split. Carbon = LEFT channel music (warm, cello/piano/strings), Silicon = RIGHT channel (glass, celesta, high sustained tones). Drift: weightless pads.
Both fall to Earth: shared low swell, both motifs briefly in octaves.

DIVERGE: LEFT accelerates — a pulsing, growing ostinato (life: 16ths, rising harmony, adding instruments each time the line drawing morphs: cell 112, jellyfish ~115, fern ~118, fish ~121, bird ~124, hand ~127). RIGHT stays almost still: one long high glass tone that very slowly drifts, rain/erosion texture far away. The contrast is the point.
CONVERGE: the left ostinato slows to meet the right; waves begin (both channels).
Seam fades: the two channels collapse to centre/stereo-normal. The two motifs meet in a gentle consonance.
BEACH: dusk waves (soft, wide), distant gulls optional (synth), a child's presence suggested only by movement sounds (sand scoop at 148, sand trickle 150–158).
'we met again': piano plays the shared motif, simple and tender.
Hand opens, grain falls (a tiny sand tick at 161.2).
'You didn't notice me': music thins to a single held note; waves.
A wave washes over (172–175), music resolves softly, fade with picture by 178.

FOUNDRY (178–216): industrial sublime. Deep furnace roar under a slow, rising chord progression; the silicon motif grows from fragile to confident. 184–196 the crystal pull: slow majestic strings, a long crescendo. 196–204 lithography: precise rhythmic pulses (like a stepper machine), 204–216 chip awakening: cascading glass arpeggios lighting up, building to the biggest musical moment so far at ~211, then drop to near-silence at 216.

CONTACT: intimate. A finger approaching glass (very soft). At 221.0 contact: a single pure tone where both motifs' first notes coincide in unison (warm + glass). 222.6 the reticles merge: the tone blooms into a soft major chord.
ANSWER: room tone returns. AI glass ticks for each typed char (229.8…, 233.0…, 236.8…). Underneath, the softest piano statement of the motif in D major.
Human caret: silence. 241.4 human keystrokes (slow, deliberate: 你 是 誰 ？). 244.2 Enter key.
AI caret appears: hold breath. 247.5 HARD CUT TO SILENCE.
KIN title: one chord, the two motifs together in unison/octaves (cello + glass), warm and luminous, long tail.
Credits: tail decays to silence by 271.
